how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:rogue-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3083:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Tablet and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3083:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:3083:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3083:completion:0: Until such time comes, you'll be under my tutelage. I will show you the ropes as some folks say. Whenever you feel prepared, come to me and I will see about training you further. Until then, practice your skills and keep them honed to a razor's edge. You'll never know when you'll need even the most insignificant ability.
rows.quest:3088:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3088:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:3088:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3088:completion:0: Now that you know where I'm holding up, I should let you know: the Shattered Hand's asked me to look out for you. They want me to train you and keep you informed of anything they might need. Even if you're not interested in helping them yet--which you'd be a fool not to be--I'll do what I can to train you... for a small fee. Come back to me anytime you think you're ready, and we'll see what you're ready to learn.
rows.quest:3096:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Scroll and speak to David Trias in Deathknell.
rows.quest:3096:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the rogue trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3096:completion:0: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.
rows.quest:3102:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind ⟦E1⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3102:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦3⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Jorik, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3102:completion:0: You're gonna find that there a number of outfits that'll covet our skills, ⟦4⟧. Adventurers, SI:7... heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside ⟦E2⟧. But you remember this, you're your own man. Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! Besides, we hold all the cards... at least, we do before the game's done. Know what I mean?
rows.quest:3102:completion:1: BAnyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. Come by anytime.
rows.quest:3109:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3109:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the rogue trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3109:completion:0: Anyway, as you start peekin' around Coldridge you'll probably have need of training at some point. You just come back to me whenever you feel you need it and I'll teach you what I know--a trick here, a maneuver there. You know, the stuff that keeps you alive and makin' a little extra coin.
rows.quest:3109:completion:1: BKeep an eye out on our gnomish friends too... they kinda got the short end of the stick what with Gnomeregan being... destroyed. They'll need our help to feel welcome.
rows.quest:3113:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Memorandum and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3113:details:0: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the rogue trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3113:completion:0: I pretty much keep to myself around here so we don't get a bad wrap for things gone missing, but if you need anything, some training or somethin', just come back anytime.
rows.quest:3113:completion:1: BYou and me got an understandin'. We know when it comes down to it you can only trust family... and that's just what we got going on here, isn't it? Regardless of Gnomeregan being... overrun, and whatever else is thrown our way, we got one another to back each other up. Right?
rows.quest:3118:obj:0: Read the Encrypted Sigil and speak to Frahun Shadewhisper in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:3118:details:0: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our rogue trainer, Frahun. It seems Frahun would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
rows.quest:3118:completion:0: Until then, know that our kind are needed more than ever in this tenuous time. Peace with the other races can fail at any moment, and there is much talk about members of the ⟦E4⟧ looking to sow even greater seeds of distrust. Remember that.
rows.quest:3118:completion:1: BAs you gain in power and feel more prepared, come back to me here and I will see about getting you some training. It's important that you know how to handle your weapon of choice, among other things.
rows.quest:6681:obj:0: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
rows.quest:6681:obj:1: BYour cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.
rows.quest:6681:details:1: BRavenholdt has taken an interest in you, young thief. We have been watching. Your style is a bit awkward but nothing we couldn't fix.
rows.quest:6681:details:2: BShould you be prepared to embark on a career as a disciple of Master Ravenholdt and member of the Assassin's League, you have only to bring the Seal of Ravenholdt (attached to this letter) to Ravenholdt Manor.
rows.quest:6681:details:3: BYour first task is to find the manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad and demonstrate your cunning.
rows.quest:6681:completion:1: BYou look a bit beaten down, but no worse for the wear.
rows.quest:6681:completion:2: BA long journey awaits you - long and rewarding. Are you prepared to finally embrace your destiny among the masters of Ravenholdt?
rows.quest:6681:completion:3: BSpeak with the guards outside. They will get you started.
rows.quest:8233:obj:0: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.
rows.quest:8233:details:0: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence. The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.
rows.quest:8233:details:1: BRavenholdt Manor is located in the ⟦E5⟧ -- look for a path in the mountains northwest of Durnhold Keep.
rows.quest:8233:completion:0: Welcome, welcome, welcome! Please, ⟦6⟧, have a seat and discuss a simple matter with me.
rows.quest:8233:completion:1: BYou see, ⟦7⟧, I've recently lost something dear to me, and to put it bluntly, I want it back at all costs. There's something in it for you, don't worry about that! Oh yes, something very nice.
rows.quest:8233:completion:2: BNow, what say you ⟦8⟧... are you up for some adventure?
rows.quest:8234:obj:0: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw ⟦E6⟧ in ⟦E7⟧. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:8234:details:0: First things first. What I've lost is a small blue bag, the contents of which are a private matter.
rows.quest:8234:details:1: BDon't bother going after the thieves, because they are already dead. What we do know is the fools couldn't get the bag open. so they sold it to some timbermaw shaman in ⟦E7⟧ as a holy relic. Clever.
rows.quest:8234:details:2: BI need you to travel to ⟦E7⟧ and retrieve it from the shaman through subtlety... or force. Better luck with the first method, I'd wager. Once acquired, take it to Archmage Xylem.
rows.quest:8234:completion:0: I see you have Lord Ravenholdt's bag. Why didn't you say so, boy?
rows.quest:8235:obj:0: Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:8235:details:0: Lord Ravenholdt has asked a favor of us both. He wishes to remove the enchantment from this bag.
rows.quest:8235:details:1: BUnfortunately, some of my books on the subject of dispelling were taken recently, only to be destroyed by savages. The remains of my books are still valuable to me.
rows.quest:8235:details:2: BIf you can bring me enough of the encoded fragments, I can piece them back together. Your best chance is to kill the beasts of ⟦E7⟧, since they have a tendency to pick up just about anything.
rows.quest:8235:completion:0: It looks like you picked up some of the better fragments. Perhaps you aren't worthless after all.
rows.quest:8236:obj:0: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
rows.quest:8236:details:0: It will take some time to decipher the fragments and remove the enchantment. When I am complete, I'll deliver the bag to Lord Ravenholdt personally.
rows.quest:8236:details:1: BThere is still the matter of the key, said to be held by a green drake known as Morphaz. The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:8236:details:2: BGather your friends and venture to his lair. Lord Ravenholdt will await your return with the key.
rows.quest:8236:completion:0: The key! I thought it lost forever. Please, take an enchanted garment from my stores -- they are reserved for rogues of exceptional skill and loyalty. It should be known that ⟦9⟧ is not to be trifled with!
rows.quest:8236:completion:1: B<Jorach opens the bag and is bathed by a golden glow from within. His eyes widen and he stares...>
rows.quest:8249:completion:0: May these knives find a place in someone's heart.
